text:
jen_support: Heads-up: Keystone customer reporting intermittent 5xx + long tail timeouts since 09:12 UTC. Ticket #12345, they see lots of 504s and p95 > 10s. repro steps attached.

devon_sre: @jen_support can you paste a sample request id and tenant id? any deploys around 09:00-09:10? :rotating_light:

jen_support: req_id=rb-cc3a8, tenant=keystone-prod. Also saw a cluster of auth call timeouts from billing (auth service) ~09:11 which caused retries from client side.

alex_infra: Looking at infra metrics — compact batcher backlog on the keystone-serving pool grew steadily starting 09:09. queue_depth peaked ~5120 and continuous-batcher backlog caused dequeue latencies to spike. KV cache cold-start/miss rate jumped at same time. Dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/metrics/keystone-prod

maria_prod: We had a small config change at 09:08 that increased batching window to 40ms to reduce token churn for another tenant. That would increase queuing under bursty auth delays. Should we revert?

devon_sre: Let's try repro locally before broad revert. Repro plan: 250 RPS of short requests (avg 6 tokens) + inject 400-600ms auth latency, run for 5m. See if queue spirals and spawns 5xx. I'll start a run now.

alex_infra: Collected a few logs from the keystone pool (sanitized):

```
[09:11:02] enqueue_delay_ms=120, queue_depth=4280, kv_miss=true, auth_wait_ms=512
[09:11:03] dequeue_attempts=0, continuous_batch_wait_ms=46, gateway_resp=504
[09:11:04] enqueue_delay_ms=230, queue_depth=4992, trace=req=rb-cc3a8
```

Those lines correspond to the customer 504s. I also see retries from the client in the same window which exacerbated the backlog.

jen_support: Customer attached their capture — they reported ~30% 504s during the spike, now asking for ETA/what changed.

devon_sre: Mitigation steps: 1) roll back batching window on keystone-serving pool to 20ms, 2) apply soft tenant burst throttle (100 RPS sustained) while we stabilize, 3) enable fallback route to smaller model variant to reduce KV pressure. I'll push rollback now.

deploy_bot: rollback initiated: rollback-2026-03-18-09:25 by devon_sre (status: in_progress)

alex_infra: Post-rollback telemetry (09:28): queue_depth trending down to ~300, p95 latency back to ~230ms, 5xx rate dropping. KV miss rate decreasing as caches warm. Link: https://console.redwood.ai/trace/req=rb-cc3a8

jen_support: Customer confirms improved latency in their latest check. They asked for a post-mortem on why the batching change combined poorly with auth timeouts — logging it to the ticket.

maria_prod: Will open a config-change checklist to flag tenant-sensitive batching changes; will revert the global rollout until we have a perf regression test.

devon_sre: Leaving throttles in place for 30m. If stable, we'll close the ticket. Followups: add load test that injects auth delays and measure queue depth, and add alert for continuous-batcher queue_depth>4000 for a pool.

jen_support: :thumbsup: customer says behavior acceptable now, I'll keep the ticket open for 1h then close if stable. Thanks team.
